lines: d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kayden Kang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d14: 🕯️ Kayden Kang is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d14: What Kayden kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d14: "Kayden's gone." Andre looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kayden." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d14: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Esteban blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.

d14: 📖 LEARNED: Bodyguard (Level 1). In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.

d14: 📖 LEARNED: Hogtie (Level 1). Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d14: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d14: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d14: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kayden Kang, 14 days. The mantle passes to Esteban Lombardi.
d14: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Esteban Lombardi, 46 — a Police officer. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm.
d14: The village's quarrel was with Kayden — and Kayden is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d14: At the grave, Andre, Tariq speak for Esteban — "Kayden trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d14: The fire knew Esteban before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
